cards.name: Transactions (rows)
cards.sql: select le.date as "Date", le.budget_month as "Month", t.description as "Description", le.amount as "Amount", le.currency as "Currency", a.name as "Account", le.category as "Category", le.subcategory as "Subcategory", 1 as "Count" from ledger_entries le left join transactions t on t.id = le.transaction_id left join accounts a on a.id = le.account_id where le.status = 'kept' order by "Date" desc, le.transaction_id, le.part

cards.name: To review
cards.sql: select le.date as "Date", t.description as "Description", le.amount as "Amount", le.currency as "Currency", a.name as "Account", t.mcc as "MCC", le.category as "Category", le.subcategory as "Subcategory" from ledger_entries le left join transactions t on t.id = le.transaction_id left join accounts a on a.id = le.account_id where le.status = 'unresolved' order by "Date" desc, le.transaction_id, le.part
